the-royal-plaza.note: USE WITH CARE. This is the site's page header, not a clean photograph: it contains a real dusk shot of the hotel's curved balconied facade with the burned-in wordmark 'The Royal Plaza GANGTOK - A Sarovar Hotel', but the site's navigation menu (HOME / ROOMS & SUITES / ...) and decorative overlays are baked into the same JPEG. It is the strongest identity evidence in the set and the only exterior recovered, but it needs cropping before it could serve as a card image.
